data.name: About.Text
data.value: PDFlight is a viewer for typical file operations (move, copy, delete, rename, mail). Frequently used target folders are kept in a list, so files can be moved in a flash without leaving the program. In addition, pages can be removed from the PDF or extracted to a new file, and another PDF file can be appended.

data.name: Adobe.Consent
data.value:
The Adobe PDF Embed API is a web service from Adobe for displaying PDF documents. It includes interactive text tools such as highlights and comments, which are not possible in the normal PDFlight view for technical reasons. If you need these functions, you can enable this optional view here. Enabling it adds a button to the main toolbar for switching it on and off. The F8 key switches quickly between the two views.
Adobe receives your IP address and technical details about the browser, stores cookies and checks the program's licence. The PDF file itself is only displayed on your device and is not uploaded. PDFlight does not send Adobe's usage log.
